summary: Prenetics Global Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing a press release dated October 12, 2026, announcing a multi-year marketing collaboration between its IM8 (US) LLC subsidiary and the National Basketball Association. IM8 becomes the Official Nutrition Partner of the NBA in Australia and eight Southeast Asian markets, covering roughly 660 million people, with NBA-themed campaigns and a 2027 NBA House activation. No securities, ownership, pricing, premium, or board-recommendation terms are involved; this is an ordinary commercial partnership disclosure and not a special situation.
